summary: Continue EEG visualization defect investigation in the user-designated local checkout; assess PPG ZLE and SC Haar SWT/Laplace preprocessing candidates.

intervals.description: Inspect the correct local checkout, preserve local changes, and continue debugging the reported EEG visualization artifact and peripheral preprocessing feasibility.
evidence: Git status inspected at named path

results: Confirmed the named checkout is on main at gold-standard commit 8c5053d and contains pre-existing local edits.
Identified correlated multichannel EEG extrema collapsing onto shared timestamps as the decimation cause; existing adaptive-extrema patch keeps the actual timestamp union within the budget.
Added an end-to-end correlated EEG regression through SweepRing; it asserts no GPU line segment exceeds 60 ms in the 20-second synthetic fixture.
Targeted render and peripheral checks passed: 12 raw preparation, 12 core rendering, 10 incremental sweep, 15 GUI rendering, 11 core peripheral, 4 GUI peripheral tests.
Full unit suite passed: 246 tests in 17.398 s after redirecting TEMP/TMP to .test-tmp.
open_items: A live native visual retest is still needed after starting the GUI with this checkout.
limitations: Initial checks were mistakenly performed in the Codex worktree before confirming and switching to the named checkout; its separate session log records the bounded investigation there.
The supplied recording timestamp (15:57:52) predates physiolab/raw_render.py modification (16:09:03), so it does not test the adaptive decimation patch.
No PhysioViewer process/window was open during this investigation; automated GUI tests passed, but live GPU appearance was not observed.
Existing PPG wavelet/SURE remains the only GUI PPG wavelet choice; ZLE is feasible but not implemented. SC Haar SWT/Laplace is already exposed as the experimental EDA Wavelet option.
